events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 years since his death
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, legendary rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas, dying six days later.

angles.name: Tupac's Enduring Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years ago, the music world lost a titan. We're remembering Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55 this year. His impact is still felt today.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: 56 years since his passing
events.blurb: Rock legend Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix's Guitar Genius
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled Jimi Hendrix, who left us 56 years ago today. He would have been 84. His guitar work still sounds like it's from the future.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Iconic Cover
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That zebra crossing photo is still one of the most famous album covers ever. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! Wishing Liam Gallagher a very happy birthday. Still a rock 'n' roll star.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released 51 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine 51 Years On
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A song with a message that resonates just as powerfully today.

events.title: The original iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Remembering the First iPod
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the first iPod dropped and changed everything. Remember loading your whole CD collection onto one device? What was the first song you put on yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Theme
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! From Shirley Bassey to Billie Eilish, which Bond theme song gets your vote as the all-time best?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: On this day, we remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: John Lennon would have been 86 today. His music and message of peace continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius, John Cleese! What's your favourite Monty Python or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album's Influence
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles delivered their sprawling 'White Album'. An incredible collection that showcased their diverse talents.

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 years since his passing
events.blurb: The music world remembers Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we lost a true showman. Remembering Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Impact
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' changed the game. A pivotal album that influenced countless artists.

events.title: John Lennon: 46 years since his death
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world mourned the tragic loss of John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon's Passing
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, the world fell silent. Remembering John Lennon, whose message of peace continues to resonate. He would have been 86.
